rules.name: cs-17-matlab-path-evidence-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT table_schema, table_name, table_type, table_rows, create_time, update_time FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name LIKE '%client_statement%' OR table_name LIKE '%cache_table%' ORDER BY table_schema, table_name

SELECT routine_schema, routine_name, routine_type, definer, created, last_altered, routine_definition FROM information_schema.routines WHERE routine_name LIKE '%client_statement%' OR routine_name LIKE '%cache%' OR routine_definition LIKE '%client_statement_report_view_cache%' ORDER BY routine_schema, routine_name

SELECT event_schema, event_name, definer, status, event_type, execute_at, interval_value, interval_field, starts, ends, last_executed, event_definition FROM information_schema.events ORDER BY event_schema, event_name

SELECT trigger_schema, trigger_name, event_object_table, action_timing, event_manipulation, action_statement FROM information_schema.triggers WHERE event_object_table LIKE '%client_statement%' OR action_statement LIKE '%client_statement%' OR action_statement LIKE '%cache_table%' ORDER BY trigger_schema, trigger_name

SELECT table_name, ordinal_position, column_name, column_type, numeric_precision, numeric_scale FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'dbsystemuat' AND table_name IN ('helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table_cfs', 'helper_client_statement_report_view_cfs') ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position

SELECT value_date, count(*) AS rows_in_cache, count(DISTINCT client_code) AS clients, count(DISTINCT counterparty_parent) AS counterparties, sum(CASE WHEN derivative_type = 'future' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS future_rows FROM dbsystemuat.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table_cfs GROUP BY value_date

SELECT * FROM dbsystemuat.client_statement_booking_order_information_table_cfs WHERE contract_number LIKE 'BFA_%' OR contract_number LIKE 'FMP_%' OR contract_number LIKE 'LIB_%' OR contract_number LIKE 'AMC_%' OR contract_number LIKE 'NFO_%'

SELECT c.client_code, split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1) AS contract_prefix, c.contract_number, c.trade_id, d.security_id, d.trade_source, c.instrument, c.product_code, c.subportfolio, c.derivative_type, c.currency, c.transaction_date, c.maturity_date, c.contract_month, c.future_expiry, c.counterparty_parent, c.traded_price, c.active_lots, c.settle_price, c.future_price, c.mult_factor, c.nc_factor, c.fx_nc_factor, c.mtm_nc, c.mtm_usd, c.netting_status, b.contract_number AS booking_contract, b.trade_date AS booking_trade_date, b.future_expiry_date AS booking_future_expiry, b.sub_account AS booking_sub_account, b.structure_name AS booking_structure, b.traded_price AS booking_traded_price, b.client_code AS booking_client_code FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table d ON d.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND d.business_unit = c.business_unit AND d.trade_id = c.trade_id AND d.is_latest_version = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (lower(contract_number)) * FROM opera.client_statement_booking_order_information_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' ORDER BY lower(contract_number), trade_date) b ON lower(b.contract_number) = lower(opera.fn_statement_swap_booking_contract_v2(c.contract_number)) WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = 'CFS' AND c.value_date = :valueDate AND c.derivative_type = 'future' ORDER BY c.client_code, c.contract_number, c.trade_id

SELECT proname, md5(prosrc) AS src_md5, length(prosrc) AS src_length, position('p_rmc OR coalesce(src_sub_account' in prosrc) > 0 AS has_v6_sub_account_only_rule, position('AS v_leg_rounded' in prosrc) > 0 AS has_leg_rounded FROM pg_proc WHERE pronamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND (proname LIKE 'fn_statement%' OR proname LIKE 'fn_refresh_client_statement%' OR proname LIKE 'fn_client_statement%') ORDER BY proname

SELECT id, dateexecuted, filename FROM opera.databasechangelog WHERE id LIKE 'fn_statement_position_summaries%' OR id LIKE 'fn_refresh_client_statement%' OR id LIKE 'fn_client_statement_snapshots%' OR id LIKE 'fn_statement_%' ORDER BY dateexecuted DESC

SELECT value_date, count(*) AS rows_in_cache, count(DISTINCT client_code) AS clients, min(created_timestamp) AS first_written, max(updated_timestamp) AS last_updated FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' GROUP BY value_date ORDER BY value_date DESC

expect.reason: CFS swap legs on the value date
